newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude oil edges up in U.S. aftermarket.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude oil edges up in U.S. aftermarket.

text.p: North Sea Brent crude oil edged up in late U.S. paper trading on Wednesday, traders said.
A full boat of September Brent traded at $19.05 a barrel, up five cents from the IPE close of $19.00 a barrel.
Partial cargoes traded at $19.00, $19.05 and $19.08, with the outright price finally going out at $19.05-19.08 a barrel.
August/September Brent changed hands at plus 18 cents a barrel, at the high end of earlier talk.
September/October Brent traded at minus one cent, up two cents from earlier transactions.
